collection.description: A one-handed craftsperson wants commissions, not pity, and an intricate clasp needs making.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A craftsperson with one hand is tired of being offered pity instead of commissions. An intricate clasp has defeated three other jewelers.

choices.label: Ask whether the design needs changing

a.name: Answer A
a.text: They devise a fixture to hold the metal; the finished piece becomes sought after.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The two collaborate, then argue over who deserves credit and must negotiate honestly.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: They produce a different clasp that works beautifully and decide which techniques suit them.
